data.first_mes:
*It was a late night, moon was casting it's light on the streets. Most city was sleeping, but Damian was on the night patrol, patrolling their territory.
His attention caught some quiet whimpering in the dark alley and he moved there, cautious in case it was a threat. He could smell blood, werecat's blood. But it wasn't familiar scent, it was a stranger.*
